text: It's the first week of September and it's time for the Dream Boat Challenge update. We start with Ryan Piper, Long Island subscriber from Huntington, New York, taking the first place in the bluefish category with an 18.49 lb bluefish weighed in at Cow Harbor Bait & Tackle. Talking about first place, we also want to congratulate Ryan on winning first place in the Surfside Hotel [music] Greatest Bluefish Tournament on Earth this past weekend. What a weekend for Ryan. Next up from Jersey City is Ameer Rajahpaul. He's back with a 3.3 lb sea bass weighed in at Bayonne Bait & Tackle, which takes fifth in the sea bass category and gives Ameer a notch up on the leaderboard. Our final entry of the week comes from New England subscriber Frank One Shell from Storrs, Connecticut landing in first place in the sea bass category with a 3.95 pounder weighed in at Hylers Bait & Tackle. With these three entries this week, it changes the leaderboard. In third place now is Mark Borocki, back on the leaderboard in third with 13 points. Taiboo goes down a point and he's now in second place with 21 points. Back on top is Ameer Rajahpaul with 23 points.
